'''Platform 177''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] located on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] landed her ship, the [[Last Chance (YT-1300 light freighter)/Legends|''Last Chance'']], on Platform 177 when she visited Cloud City shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="IDC" />

*''[[Imperial Double-Cross]]''
